name: Promax Power Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2004, Promax Power Ltd is involved EPC Power & Solar projects and other related activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC - Power & Solar) projects for Electrification, Power Substations, Underground Cabling from 11kV to          220kV. Company also provides Turnkey execution of Civil Infrastructure projects viz. Industrial buildings and Turnkey execution of water infrastructure management projects viz. water transmission and distribution work

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.14% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -4.08%
